reaction: The grain formation was a satisfying, clear result.

reaction: The reminder that dust is a small fraction of the gas, but provides surfaces for molecules, was useful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Cooling silicate-forming vapor into grains made the progression from mineral ingredients to microscopic rock especially clear and satisfying.

leastWorthwhile.text: The consecutive cloud-enrichment steps felt somewhat repetitive, even though they established multiple stellar sources.

surprise.text: The ejecta first produced a shock that heated and compressed gas, rather than immediately producing a mixed cloud.

arbitrary.text: Using open space to cool the shock was not obvious to me beforehand, though the result explained that radiation carried energy away.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how the mixed dust and gas develop into a planetary system, especially after learning that the grains can later separate.
